name: The Binding
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.

The demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, adventurer. You must subdue it fully.

Only then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
narrative.objectives: Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a champion has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.This trial did not break you, adventurer, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.
narrative.requestItemsText: The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.Do not let it, adventurer.
